components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On the response this is
            the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The structured first line of the postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed,
            upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional structured second line of the postal address. When present it is
            stored and returned normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits
            and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present
            it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            shares its household (same last name and postcode); it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the
            household link — the householdId is always derived from last name and postcode.
            Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as title + ' ' + lastName when a
                title is supplied, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is named after the calendar year in which it ends, so a July-to-December
                date belongs to the following calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name (case-insensitive, collapsed whitespace) and postcode, so owners with the same
                last name and postcode share it automatically. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through, the
                lower-case SHA-256 hex over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the
                email component is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f5c1e0b2d47689fe10c2b4a6d8091f3c5e7a9b0d2f4681a3c5e7092b4d6f81'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, computed on creation. Starts at 0; add 2
                when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3
                or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel; 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email
                address, otherwise 'PHONE'.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string

        title:
          title: Title

        status:

        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string

          readOnly: true

        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On the response this is
            the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The structured first line of the postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed,
            upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional structured second line of the postal address. When present it is
            stored and returned normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits
            and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present
            it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            shares its household (same last name and postcode); it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the
            household link — the householdId is always derived from last name and postcode.
            Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as title + ' ' + lastName when a
                title is supplied, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is named after the calendar year in which it ends, so a July-to-December
                date belongs to the following calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name (case-insensitive, collapsed whitespace) and postcode, so owners with the same
                last name and postcode share it automatically. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through, the
                lower-case SHA-256 hex over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the
                email component is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f5c1e0b2d47689fe10c2b4a6d8091f3c5e7a9b0d2f4681a3c5e7092b4d6f81'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, computed on creation. Starts at 0; add 2
                when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3
                or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:

                - STANDARD_METRO

              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel; 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email
                address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:

                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the same
                business day as this owner's registrationDate, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning

              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented the `ownerSegment` field, formatted `<TIER>_<AREA>`, on the owner response.

   - TIER = `PREMIUM` when `membershipLevel >= 3`, else `STANDARD`.
   - AREA = `METRO` when the locality is a known region (`NSW`, `VIC`, `QLD`), else `REGIONAL`.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added an `ownerSegment` MapStruct mapping.
